objective: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

description: I'm a goblin of my word, kid. Here's your 500 pound chicken.
What a gnome wants with a 500 pound chicken, I'll never know...
Probably to sleep in it... Dirty gnomes...
completion: <Narain mashes two fists into the huge chicken, stuffing his face full of Dirge's delicious delicacy.>
MMmmm... This is unbelievable! Best chicken I've ever had!
